E-camp-camp-0084.recDirections: From 100 Mile House, travel north on Hwy 97 for about 1.5 km, then turn east onto Canim-Hendrix Lake Road. Travel about 20 km to the community of Forest Grove, then turn right/east at the 3-way stop sign, remaining on the Canim-Hendrix Lake Road. Proceed another 25 km, at which point the road becomes the 6000 Road (gravel). Travel to 60-18km and turn right onto the Spanish Creek Forest Service Road (7000 Road). Travel 9.4 km and turn right onto the Pendleton Forest Service Road (7100 Road). Continue another 10.5km to the Pendleton Lake Recreation Site.
